name: Constance
faction: The Cremators (posed as a member of the Annihilation Gang's Ever-Flame Mansion)
description: Known publicly as 'The Dahlia,' Constance poses as the second daughter of crime lord Duke Inferno within the Annihilation Gang's Ever-Flame Mansion. She is later revealed to actually be a Cremator, a rogue sub-faction of Memokeepers who eliminate memories they deem worthless; she became playable in Version 3.8.
